unresolved: KNOWN COMPROMISE - circulation continuity: the original shows no wall ink at x698-790 on the corridor north wall (wall faces y957/969 measured only x524-696 and x790-988); the vertical corridor continues openly into the bottom-wing hall. candidate_01 declares P_corr_north_w continuous, so the circulation is represented as TWO spaces (corridor_open L-shape and F1_S13 hall) with NO opening between them - the hall/meeting zone is reachable only via D_main_entr or through meeting-room doors D_C1/D_C2, which is a connectivity error. Faithful alternatives were attempted and rejected by the builder: splitting the wall at the gap (drafts 005/006/008) and declaring an open passage on it (draft 007) both failed the seed-space check with shifting conflict pairs; a post-build add_opening of the passage (candidate_02) left the opening unbuilt (source.opening_unbuilt). Keep this defect in mind for any downstream use.
